name: laya-pilot
description: Generate and replay browser test cases from a live page or an Excel workbook

scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: npm run format:web:check && npm run format:python:check

scripts.format:python:check: uv tool run --from ruff==0.15.21 ruff format --check .
